text: Developer REST API gives programmatic access to meeting transcripts, structured notes, and more, for uses like feeding transcripts to an LLM
quote: The Developer API opens that data to you: transcripts, structured notes, and more, all available through standard REST calls.

text: Self-serve API key generation with descriptive names; multiple keys allowed, one per application recommended
quote: Generate a new API key for your application, giving it a descriptive name. You can have multiple API keys, and we recommend generating a different one for each application

text: API requests authenticate with an API key sent in a request header
quote: Include your API key in the `X-API-KEY` header of every request

text: Webhooks send real-time HTTP POST notifications on events such as an AI note being generated or an action item being completed
quote: When an event happens (like an AI note being generated or an action item being completed), Fellow sends an HTTP POST request to the URL you specify with details about the event.

text: Webhooks let integrations react immediately to changes in Fellow without polling
quote: This enables you to build integrations that react immediately to changes in Fellow, without needing to poll for updates.

text: API endpoint to list recordings with optional filters and pagination
quote: List recordings with optional filters and pagination.

text: API endpoint to list action items, with a scope filter for all, assigned-to-me, or assigned-to-others
quote: The `scope` filter controls which action items are returned: (no scope - default): All action items the user has access to assigned_to_me: Only action items assigned to the authenticated user

text: API endpoint to list notes with optional filters and pagination
quote: List notes with optional filters and pagination.

text: All list endpoints use cursor-based pagination with consistent performance at any depth
quote: The Fellow Developer API uses cursor-based pagination for all list endpoints. This approach provides consistent performance regardless of how deep you paginate

text: Incremental sync of changes by combining an updated_at_start filter with ascending updated_at ordering
quote: To page through a window of changes, combine `updated_at_start` with `order_by: updated_at_asc`.

text: API can append Fellow Markdown to the end of a note's agenda without altering existing content
quote: Add Fellow Markdown to the end of a note's agenda, leaving the rest of the content in place.

text: API can prepend Fellow Markdown to the start of a note's agenda without altering existing content
quote: Add Fellow Markdown to the start of a note's agenda, leaving the rest of the content in place.

text: API find-and-replace in a note agenda that requires exactly one match and returns 422 with no change otherwise
quote: Replace the single occurrence of `find` in a note's agenda with Fellow Markdown. `find` must match exactly once. A missing or ambiguous match is a 422 and changes nothing.

text: API can overwrite a note's agenda content and/or rename the note
quote: Write a note's agenda and/or rename the note. Provide `content_fellow_markdown`, `title`, or both.

text: Fellow Markdown note format: GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus extensions for action items with assignees and due dates, talking points, mentions, tags, highlights
quote: Fellow Markdown is the format the API uses for reading and writing note content. It is GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus Fellow extensions for the things Fellow notes have and plain markdown doesn't: action items with assignees and due dates, t

text: Fellow Markdown round-trips: note content read from the API can be sent back unchanged to the agenda endpoint
quote: The format round-trips: the `content_fellow_markdown` you read from a note is exactly what you can send back to `POST /note/{id}/agenda`.

text: API endpoint returns info about the authenticated user and their workspace
quote: Get information about the authenticated user and their workspace.

text: Recordings via API include diarized, timestamped transcripts linked to a note
quote: A Recording represents a meeting recap in Fellow, and associated metadata. Each Recording is associated with a Note, and can contain information such as: Diarized and timestamped transcripts

text: Recording metadata includes the virtual call URL (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams)
quote: Diarized and timestamped transcripts... Virtual call URL (Google Meet, Zoom, MS Teams URLs)

text: Recording metadata includes event attendee email addresses and agenda content
quote: Event attendees (email addresses)... Agenda content

text: Large transcripts are excluded from API responses by default and are requested explicitly with an include parameter
quote: Transcripts can be quite large, and are not included in API responses by default... These must be explicitly requested using the `include` parameter

text: Upload an existing meeting recording into Fellow from a media URL for background processing
quote: Use this endpoint to bring an existing meeting recording into Fellow. After submitting the media file's URL, Fellow processes the recording in the background

text: Check the processing status of an API-uploaded recording: in progress, completed, or failed
quote: Use this endpoint to check the status of a single API-uploaded recording. Provide the upload’s recording ID to retrieve its latest state and confirm whether processing is still in progress, completed successfully, or failed.

text: List all API recording uploads with their processing state to monitor many at once
quote: monitor progress across multiple recordings in one place. Use it to quickly check what's pending, completed, or failed without looking up each upload individually.

text: API can mark an action item complete or incomplete
quote: Mark an action item as complete or incomplete.

text: API can archive an action item by marking it as won't do
quote: Archive an action item by marking it as won't do.

text: Super Admin API keys can act on behalf of any workspace user via an X-On-Behalf-Of header, for example to build per-user admin dashboards
quote: Super Admin API keys can make requests on behalf of any user in the workspace using the `X-On-Behalf-Of` header.

text: Super Admin API lets Enterprise admins retrieve, export, and delete workspace-wide data for legal backup and privacy erasure
quote: Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes and to erase third‑party data in lin

text: Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API
quote: Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.

text: MCP Server lets you ask your AI assistant about your meetings without writing code
quote: Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.

text: AI chatbots like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can access meeting recaps, notes, and action items
quote: Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items

text: MCP Connector works with any AI tool that supports connectors, avoiding platform lock-in
quote: Fellow's MCP Connector works with any AI tool that supports connectors, so you're never locked into one platform

text: Ask natural-language questions about past meetings, such as action items this week or decisions from last month
quote: Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"

text: Workspace admins choose which MCP tools members' AI assistants may use
quote: As a workspace admin, you decide which MCP tools your members’ AI assistants can use.

text: MCP Server only exposes data the user already has access to in Fellow
quote: The MCP Server only gives users access to the data they already have access to within Fellow.

text: Workspace owners control MCP enablement, can revoke connections anytime, and see each connection's last-used timestamp
quote: Workspace owners decide when the MCP Server is enabled, can revoke connections at any time, and see the last-used timestamp for every connection

text: Record with a visible bot or botless desktop audio capture across Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
quote: record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings

text: Records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings on Zoom, Meet, Teams, and Slack huddles, claiming human-level accuracy
quote: Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles with enterprise-grade security and human-level accuracy.

text: Users can choose when to record, pause, or resume capture to keep parts of a conversation off the record
quote: Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.

text: Every conversation gets a full searchable transcript for access to past context
quote: Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.

text: Automatic meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting
quote: You automatically receive a clear meeting summary, suggested AI action items, decisions, and topic-based minutes for every meeting.

text: Organization-wide policies govern how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained, while users control what they share
quote: Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained, while giving your team control over what they shar

text: Configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention
quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.

quote: Keyword tracking

text: Transcript redaction
quote: Transcript redaction

text: Audio and video file uploads
quote: Audio and video uploads
